title: Web Automation & DOM Interaction API
summary: Playwright-inspired automation engine for SPAs, MutationObserver-backed waiting, form filling, and keystroke dispatch.

sections.title: Waiting for Elements & URLs
sections.content: Kromium's waitForSelector injects an in-V8 MutationObserver to avoid IPC polling overhead, resuming your coroutine the millisecond the element appears.

sections.title: Form Inputs & Keystroke Simulation
sections.content: Automate forms using fill, type, selectOption, and click.

sections.title: DOM Extraction & State Querying
sections.content: Inspect DOM properties and content directly without writing raw JavaScript strings.

codeSnippet.code:
val text = browser.automation.getTextContent("h1.title")
val href = browser.automation.getAttribute("a#download-link", "href")
val isVisible = browser.automation.isVisible(".modal-dialog")
val totalItems = browser.automation.count(".item-row")

sections.title: JavaScript Bridge & Async Evaluation
sections.content: Execute arbitrary JavaScript and await results via browser.jsBridge.

codeSnippet.code:
val result = browser.jsBridge.evaluateJavaScript("window.innerWidth * window.devicePixelRatio")
val html = browser.jsBridge.getHtml()
